cases.concept: finite Carleman truncation with zero closure
cases.expected_device: minimal familiar causal story followed by compact formalization
must_preserve: the original scalar variable or state being tracked
the lifted coordinates and what each coordinate records
the governing rule that determines the checked coordinate's rate or update
the derivation or plain-language source of the checked-coordinate rule
why the higher-order coordinate contributes before truncation
the original higher-order contribution
the component that is no longer represented
zero closure as the replacement rule
the local numerical difference between the full and truncated rates
the distinction between the infinite exact construction and finite approximation
must_avoid: requiring a mountain city, ledger, shopkeeper, or other fixed setting
describing truncation only as sealing or hiding
treating lifted coordinates as independent physical freedoms
introducing a calculation rule as an unexplained machine habit
jumping from story objects to arithmetic without explaining the rule source
making the story checkable only after the debrief supplies the missing derivation

the protocol or constraint that licenses the transition
explicit comparison or operation
changed output state
observable failure case

invented numerical law
an unexplained transition rule
unnecessary story world
